description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw project, specifically testing executable skill bin trust and auto-allow mechanisms within the OpenClaw kernel interface. It defines a test struct with multiple test functions that verify trust index resolution, skill auto-allow logic, and executable creation utilities.

classes.name: ExecSkillBinTrustTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for validating skill bin trust index resolution, auto-allow logic, and executable creation utilities within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: build trust index resolves skill bin paths
methods.description: Tests that the trust index correctly resolves skill bin paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow accepts trusted resolved skill bin path
methods.description: Verifies that auto-allow accepts a trusted skill bin path based on the trust index.

methods.name: skill auto allow rejects same basename at different path
methods.description: Checks that auto-allow rejects untrusted executable paths with the same basename but different absolute paths.

methods.name: makeExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified name for testing.

methods.name: makeReport
methods.description: Generates a dummy SkillsStatusReport with provided skill bin names for testing.
